skill.name: project-planning
skill.description: Generate project planning documents from a project concept, including a project vision, architecture decision record, technical specification, and development roadmap.
skill.summary: Create structured planning documents for AI-assisted software projects.
skill.author: ByronWilliamsCPA

security_audit.summary: Manual review found the static detections are false positives caused by Markdown examples, inline code formatting, fixed local validation snippets, and template links. The skill generates project-local planning documents, with no evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, secret access, network access, or remote code execution.

content.user_title: Plan Software Projects with Structured Docs
content.value_statement: New software projects often lose context before implementation starts. This skill turns a project concept into aligned vision, ADR, technical spec, and roadmap documents.
actual_capabilities: Generates a Project Vision and Scope document from a project concept.
Creates architecture decision records for important technical choices.
Builds a technical implementation specification with stack, architecture, data model, and security sections.
Produces a phased development roadmap with milestones, tasks, dependencies, and success criteria.
Validates planning documents for placeholders, required sections, length, and local links.
Synthesizes planning documents into a project plan with phase branch guidance.
limitations: It cannot guarantee technical correctness without human review.
Optional consensus review requires the zen-mcp-server tool.
The validation script checks document structure, not implementation quality.
Roadmap estimates may need adjustment after discovery work.

use_cases.title: Start a New Software Project
use_cases.description: Turn an idea into a compact planning pack before writing code.

use_cases.title: Align Technical Decisions
use_cases.description: Document architecture choices, constraints, and implementation scope before assigning work.

use_cases.title: Prepare AI Coding Context
use_cases.description: Create focused documents that Claude, Codex, or Claude Code can reference later.

prompt_templates.title: Create Initial Planning Docs
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new project idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-planning to create planning documents for this project: [describe users, problem, platform, and constraints].

prompt_templates.title: Plan from Existing Code
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a repository already has structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current repository and create planning documents that match the existing stack, conventions, and constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Strengthen Architecture Rationale
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the first draft needs better decisions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the generated ADRs and improve the rationale, alternatives, consequences, and links to the technical specification.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize Execution Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt after planning documents exist.
prompt_templates.prompt: Synthesize the planning documents into a project plan, map roadmap phases to branch names, and create a Phase 0 task list.

output_examples.input: A CLI app that helps freelancers track invoices, payments, and late follow-ups.
output: Project vision defining users, invoice workflows, and measurable MVP goals.
ADR explaining local storage trade-offs and migration considerations.
Technical specification covering commands, data model, validation, and errors.
Roadmap with foundation, billing workflows, reporting, and release polish phases.

output_examples.input: An internal web tool for reviewing weekly support ticket trends.
output: Vision document describing analysts, support managers, reports, and scope limits.
ADR explaining framework and data storage choices.
Tech spec with components, endpoints, security notes, and performance targets.
Roadmap with milestones for ingestion, dashboards, permissions, testing, and documentation.

output_examples.input: Existing planning docs are generated. Create one implementation plan.
output: Project plan with summary, scope, branch strategy, phases, risks, and next steps.
Phase 0 task list tied to roadmap deliverables and setup work.

best_practices: Provide the project goal, users, constraints, and preferred stack in the first prompt.
Review assumptions, timelines, and ADR trade-offs before implementation.
Update planning documents when architecture, scope, or roadmap decisions change.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated documents as final requirements without stakeholder review.
Do not start broad implementation before the planning documents agree.
Do not commit planning documents that still contain placeholders.

faq.question: What documents does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates a project vision, architecture decision record, technical specification, and development roadmap.

faq.question: Can it work with an existing codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use repository structure and known constraints when creating planning documents.

faq.question: Does it require external services?
faq.answer: Basic generation does not. Optional consensus review requires the zen-mcp-server consensus tool.

faq.question: Does the validation script modify files?
faq.answer: No. It reads local planning documents and reports structural issues.

faq.question: Is it suitable for non-software projects?
faq.answer: It is designed for software projects that need technical specs, ADRs, and roadmaps.

faq.question: How should teams use the roadmap?
faq.answer: Treat it as a starting plan and review estimates before assigning work.
